docs: docs/12 F29 items (2) and (3); docs/13 A7 (phase R4, H17.10) and A8 items 1 and 6; docs/11 section 5 (every literal learning path)
status: SMOKE of the build task: the controls chain on the R4 smoke store (2,000 images, C = 4,096, seed 100) against a smoke gpu run made with ssl_r4_images.py --stage gpu --epochs 2; never reported; run with --data-root in a scratch directory
r4_config_note: every R4 parameter (store, engine, F1, epochs, young fraction, chunk size, probe budgets, draws, LR grid, folds, lr_max_iter) is read from r4_config at run time and never copied here; every stage checks that the gpu run it reads was made with exactly this r4_config (sha256)
gpu_lock: shared for replay, twin, randbank (engine cuda) and diag; none for probe and report

rungs.c0y: max(1, ceil(young_fraction x nb)) batches of epoch 1: the registered C0y (its state hash is checked equal to the gpu run's main.young.state_hash)

young_ladder.rounding: round half up of nb x percent / 100 in exact integers, (nb x percent + 50) // 100, at least 1; nb = batches of epoch 1 (490 in the seed-100 exploratory run, so c0y 5, pct5 25, pct10 49, epoch1 490 [derived: results/20260924T220231Z_ssl_r4_gpu_seed100_exploratory, main.batches_per_epoch]); rungs at the same batch share one state, one checkpoint and one code file
young_ladder.max_ladder: per seed and per budget the rung with the highest mean LR accuracy over the draws (ties: the earlier rung)

twin_overrides.note: the R1 twin overrides (experiments/cvtm/configs/ssl_r1_controls.json, block literal_paths, lists every docs/11 section 5 path and why these values switch it off); kept on: seeding, recycling, the MIN_FREE top-up, vote learning, vetoes. Checks per run: derived p_ins_q32 = p_neg_q32 = inv_s_q32 = 0, no insertion counted, sum(G) < 2^62 at the end, per batch no retained literal lowered or crossing 128 and every entering literal included, per epoch the R1 literal-freezing view

random_bank.positions: the 49 patch positions of every pool image (the pretraining target positions before F1); literal draw as tmlm.ssl.confirm.random_bank (stream SeedSequence([20260925, 0xA8, 3, seed]), n_lit uniform on 1..3, position uniform, column (offset -8..-1, +1..+8; kind 0..3) uniform among unused offsets, redraw when no literal is true), so every true (position, column) pair is equally likely and a literal is drawn with its frequency at the pool patch positions
random_bank.seed: the pretraining seed of the gpu run (one bank per seed)
random_bank.code: counts of (fired clause, quadrant) over the 49 patch positions, exactly the image code of ssl_r4_images.image_codes (offset 0 is never a literal, so nothing is hidden)
random_bank.chunk_note: 40 images = 1,960 positions per firing chunk: the smoke (C = 4,096, 500 images per chunk) peaked at 2,634 MiB of device memory (whole-GPU nvidia-smi sample, results/20260930T170204Z_ssl_r4c_randbank_smoke); candidates grow with C, so C = 65,536 at 40 images is about 16 x 2.6 GB x 40 / 500, near 3.4 GB [derived, upper bound]

diag.banks: registered main.final, main.young (C0y) and randkm.final of the gpu run; the replayed ladder rungs (a rung with the same state hash as a bank already listed is not repeated); the twin; the random bank (literal census only)

quantities.included_literals_per_clause: histogram over alive clauses (tmlm census of experiments/ssl_r1_controls.census_of)
quantities.negated_share: fraction of included literals negated and of clauses with a negated literal
quantities.bag_share: fraction of included literals that are bag literals and of clauses with one
quantities.owned_clauses_per_class_vs_T: per class, alive clauses with a positive vote (docs/11 'owns'); quantiles and the number of classes below and at least T (T = 64)
quantities.include_boundary_crossings_per_epoch: counted on the device between consecutive batch ends of the replayed main arm and of the twin: retained slots (same literal, same clause incarnation) whose state crossed 128, over retained slots whose state changed; slot turnover (insertion, seeding, eviction, recycling) reported separately. Transitions that cancel inside one batch are not visible (batch granularity; the engine applies all events of a batch in one kernel pass and exposes no per-event trace)
quantities.class_sum_histograms: the engine's vote sums at the 490,000 dev patch positions under the frozen 15 percent mask (the forward pass of ssl_r4_images.masked_top1): gold class, top class, margin gold minus best other, signed log2 bins, fractions at or beyond +-T. The engine's closest analogue of a TM class sum; its feedback gates use the sums clipped at +-T
quantities.not_defined: random bank: no votes (no owned classes, no class sums, no masked top-1) and no training (no transitions); randkm.final: not replayed here (no transitions)

report.rows: code_main (registered probe cells) minus: each ladder rung, max(ladder) chosen per seed, the twin, the random bank; also minus the registered code_young and bovw for context; units points (100 x accuracy), paired over (seed, draw)
report.statistics: two-level bootstrap of A8 item 1 (tmlm.ssl.confirm.two_level_bootstrap: resample seeds, then draws within each resampled seed; 10,000 resamples), the seed-level Student-t interval (tmlm.ssl.confirm.seed_t_interval) and the driver's flat paired bootstrap over (seed, draw) (ssl_r4_images.paired_bootstrap)
report.label_rule: A8 item 1 on the single image code: 'literal-learning credit' iff at 10 labels per class (the H17.10 budget) code_main minus max(ladder) AND code_main minus the twin are each at least 1.0 point with the two-level bootstrap interval excluding 0 (lo > 0), on all 3 seeds; otherwise 'no literal-learning credit'; INCOMPLETE if a seed is missing. The same components at 100 labels per class are reported without a label. A8's 'all-clauses AND dimension-matched' conjunct has no image analogue (R4 registers one code) and is not applied
report.checks: every control cell's labelled sample equals the registered cell's (labelled_sha256); the C0y rung's predictions equal the registered code_young predictions cell for cell (pred_sha256): the probe path is the registered one
